question: How much screen time have I been averaging on Instagram per day?

gold_sessions.user_turns:
[turn 0] Hey, I've been trying to cut down on my social media usage, but it's hard when I'm waiting to hear back from friends or family on WhatsApp or Facebook Messenger. Can you suggest some ways to stay connected with loved ones without getting sucked into mindless scrolling?

[turn 2] I like the idea of designating specific check-in times. But do you think it's possible to also set a time limit for social media apps like Instagram, so I don't end up spending too much time on them?

[turn 4] I've been averaging around 2 hours of screen time on Instagram per day for the past two weeks, which is way too much. Do you think setting a time limit of 30 minutes per day would be a good starting point for me?

[turn 6] What are some alternative activities I can do during my breaks to fill the time, instead of reaching for my phone?

[turn 8] I think I'll try doodling or drawing during my breaks. I used to enjoy drawing when I was younger, and it might be a great way to express myself creatively and relax. Do you have any tips for getting started with doodling or drawing?

[turn 10] I think I'll try to doodle during my breaks at work. I'll start with simple shapes and patterns and see where it takes me. Do you have any favorite doodle patterns or designs that I could try?
